description: Call this before your agent buys a Solana token. One call runs five isolated checks: token risk (sell-side skim and fee/hook controls), top-holder concentration (the factor behind our bundle score), stablecoin lookalike detection, xStock status (issuer mint list, lookalikes and issuer objections), and optionally an x402 payee check (verdict ok, caution, do_not_pay or unknown). Unknown mints return HTTP 404 before payment. Returns verdict avoid, caution, ok or unknown, each factor's status and confidence, and plain limits. A slow or failed factor returns unknown; unknown is never ok. Capped at 3 seconds. If every factor fails the call returns HTTP 502 and you are not charged. Part of the agent spend firewall bundle (payee_check + seller_report + pretrade); see /.well-known/x402 bundles. Costs $0.014 USDC (14000 base units) via x402. The same price is charged for HTTP GET /pretrade. An unpaid HTTP call returns 402 even when the query is missing or invalid. A signed call with invalid arguments is rejected before settlement and is not charged. A successful result can set cached, stale, and cacheAgeMs. stale true means a previous result was served while a refresh runs or the upstream failed. You are charged only when the tool result is not an error.
name: pretrade
